mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle, compressing discount rates on equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) despite FEDFUNDS declining for 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: An unemployment rate exceeding 5% percent triggers investor caution, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20d returns remain non-negative despite UNRATE crossing above 5%.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent growth in both personal consumption (GDPC1) and housing demand (HOUST) signals robust economic momentum, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: both GDPC1 and HOUST rising > 1% in 3 months
failure_condition: GDPC1 and HOUST do not both rise >1% in 3 months, or 20d returns are not positive.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained contraction in the industrial production index (INDPRO) below 98.5 during a contractionary supply cycle reduces production capacity, prompting investors to buy undervalued assets and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO exceeds 98.5 for >1 month during contractionary regime, or 60d returns are not positive.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden rise in the federal funds rate above 4% signals aggressive monetary tightening, raising borrowing costs and dampening equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS remains ≤4.0% despite trigger, or 5d returns are not negative.

mechanism_narrative: Rising employment (PAYEMS) coupled with falling unemployment (UNRATE) indicates a strengthening labor market, boosting corporate profits and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS rises > 0.5% while UNRATE falls > 0.1% in 3 months
failure_condition: PAYEMS does not rise while UNRATE falls >0.1% in 3 months, or 20d returns are not positive.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the industrial production index (INDPRO) above 100 signals expanding production capacity, fostering economic growth and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO does not rise >2% over 6 months, or 60d returns are not positive.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in personal consumption (GDPC1) during a late-cycle demand peak signals overvaluation, prompting investors to exit equities and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 falls > 2% from peak in late-cycle period
failure_condition: GDPC1 does not decline >2% in late-cycle period, or 20d returns are not negative.
